question: Where can I get the register of water abstraction rights and concessions in the United States, with location, holder, use, authorised volume and status?

answer.summary: There is no national register of water rights in the United States; each state creates and publishes its own. California (CalWATRS files on data.ca.gov, weekly CSV and API), Colorado (CDSS REST API, anonymous quota) and Oregon (OWRD point-of-diversion layers plus the WRIS record viewer) were tested. They give location, use, amounts and status, and each has a holder field. Vocabularies, units and row definitions differ by state. The multi-state WaDE/WestDAAT service was taken offline in October 2026.
main_caveats: No national register exists in the evidence found: rights are recorded by each state, and only California, Colorado and Oregon were tested.
California's older eWRIMS flat files are marked discontinued (not updated since July 2025); the current CalWATRS datasets cover participants and geospatial links.
Row counts are not right counts: CA rows are right-feature links, CO rows are decreed lines per structure, OR rows are point-of-diversion by use rows.
Volumes are not comparable: CA face value in acre-feet, CO CFS or AF by decree, OR mostly cfs. None measures actual extraction.
WSWC took the WaDE/WestDAAT multi-state service offline in October 2026 and directs users to state agencies, which remain authoritative.
Holder fields hold personal data; names and addresses were inspected only as counts and are not reproduced.
answer.confidence_reason: Queries were reproduced and counted in three states; the other states and any aggregators were not tested, and some counts come from sampled fields.

attributes.note: WGS84 points of diversion in CA, CO and OR; CA places of use are listed without shapes. Coordinates only, no region-wide register.
attributes.gap_note: Verified in three states only (CA, CO, OR). Other states and any national register were not tested; Utah and Idaho pages timed out and Washington returned 403 on 2026-11-24.

attributes.note: A holder field exists in CA (participants file), CO (associatedContacts) and OR (name fields, WRIS contact block); names not reproduced.

Other states and any national register were not tested; Utah and Idaho pages timed out and Washington returned 403 on 2026-11-24.

attributes.note: Use published as purposes text (CA), coded uses 0-X (CO) and use code plus group (OR); vocabularies differ by state.
attributes.gap_note: Use vocabularies were not mapped across states. Other states and any national register were not tested; Utah and Idaho pages timed out and Washington returned 403 on 2026-11-24.

attributes.note: CA face value in acre-feet; CO net amounts in CFS or AF per row; OR mostly rate in cfs with sparse acre-feet. None is actual diversion.

Places of use and conveyance lines are listed without geometry.

coverage.geographic: California only (state-administered rights, applications and claims)

unit.value: One row = one link between a right/claim (or change petition) and one mapped feature at a point in time.
unit.quote: A right with several points of diversion appears on several rows, and a point shared by several rights appears once for each right.

inclusion_rule.value: Links have status Active or Inactive; many migrated from eWRIMS have no start or end date.
inclusion_rule.quote: Many links were migrated from the Electronic Water Rights Information Management System (eWRIMS) and have no start or end date.

reference_date.value: CKAN metadata_modified 2026-11-23; update frequency stated as weekly.

exclusions.quote: Places of use and storage, facilities, and lines of conveyance are listed without their shapes.

key_fields.meaning: Right/application/claim identifier (for example A027261).
Point of Diversion, Point of Storage, Point of Rediversion, Place of Use, Place of Storage, Line of Conveyance, Place Of Facility.
Status of the feature link (Active/Inactive) and of the right itself (Licensed, Permitted, Registered, Revoked, Cancelled...).
Approved face value of a right (or requested yearly amount of an application); the unit observed is Acre-feet.
Authorised, requested or claimed purposes of use as text (for example Industrial, Municipal, Irrigation).
WGS84 coordinates of the feature (points only).
Priority date of the right.

how_to_use.example_result: HTTP 200, 6 rows for right A027261 (Licensed, face value 33,500 acre-feet) split between Point of Diversion and Point of Storage features; the face value repeats on every row.
steps: Open the dataset page and download GEOSPATIAL_RELATIONSHIPS (ZIP with one CSV) or use the CKAN datastore_search endpoint with resource_id 1cc571c2-f761-4101-931e-c570578c5a21.
Filter GR_FEATURE_TYPE = 'Point of Diversion' for intake points; keep GR_STATUS = 'Active' and check WR_APP_CLAIM_STATUS for the status of the right itself.
Count distinct WR_APP_CLAIM_NAME for rights; never count rows or sum WR_APP_FACEVALUE across rows.
Join to the participants file on WR_APP_CLAIM_NAME if the holder relationship is needed (see source ca-calwatrs-participants).
reading_traps: Face value is repeated on every feature row of the same right: summing rows multiplies the authorised volume.
Face value is present for 24,547 of 55,711 distinct rights/claims (44%); riparian and many pre-1914 claims have none.
Legacy eWRIMS flat files on the same portal are marked DISCONTINUED and do not match current records.
POLY_MAXFLOWRATE is often 0.0 in the sample inspected; do not read it as an authorised rate without checking.

problems: The ZIP download answers with a 302 redirect before the 200.
CSV row count (109,480) matched the CKAN DataStore total.

sources.name: CDSS REST web services: water rights net amounts, transactions and structures
sources.publisher: Colorado Division of Water Resources (DWR), Colorado Decision Support Systems
sources.format: JSON (and CSV via format parameter) over a REST API
sources.adds: Colorado court-decreed water rights by structure with coordinates, decreed uses, absolute and conditional net amounts, priority dates, and a structures endpoint with in-use status and associated contacts.
sources.summary: Colorado's REST API serves court-decreed water rights by structure with coordinates, decreed uses, absolute and conditional amounts and priority dates, plus structure status and contacts.
sources.coverage_note: Colorado only. 173,294 net-amount rows across seven divisions; anonymous quota of 1,000 calls and 600,000 rows per day.
caveats: Amounts are in CFS or acre-feet depending on the row.
Rows are decreed lines, not distinct rights.

unit.value: netamount: one row per decreed water-right line of a structure (WDID) after summing court actions; transaction: one row per court-decreed action.
unit.quote: Returns current status of a water right based on all of its court decreed actions

inclusion_rule.value: Court-decreed rights recorded in HydroBase; absolute and conditional amounts are separate columns.

reference_date.value: Live service; ResultDateTime 2026-11-24 on the test calls; each record has its own lastModified.

update_frequency.value: Not stated on the pages read.

exclusions.value: Anonymous users are limited to 1,000 calls per day and 600,000 rows.
exclusions.quote: anonymous users are limited to 1,000 calls per day and 600,000 rows of data.

key_fields.meaning: DWR unique structure identifier (join key across endpoints).
Structure coordinates with an accuracy label (for example Digitized), plus PLSS legal location and UTM.
Coded beneficial uses: 0 storage, 1 irrigation, 2 municipal, 3 commercial, 4 industrial, 5 recreation... X all beneficial uses.
Net decreed amount, absolute or conditional, in the decree unit (CFS or AF); unit varies by row.
Priority information used to rank rights.
Current in-use code of the structure: A active, B abandoned by the court, C conditional, D duplicate, H historical, I inactive, N non-existent, U active without records.
Contact names associated with the structure (holder-type field); names not reproduced.

how_to_use.example_result: HTTP 200 JSON with 8 net-amount rows for structure WDID 0400588 (ditch, Boulder County): decreedUses, decreedUnits C, netAbsolute values, appropriation dates 1875-1987, lat 40.259 lon -105.176.
steps: Call /api/v2/waterrights/netamount/ with a filter: wdid, division, waterDistrict, county, gnisId or locationSearch; without a filter the full table is returned (173,294 rows).
Raise pageSize (up to 500,000) to page less; anonymous quota is 1,000 calls and 600,000 rows per day; an API key raises limits.
Call /api/v2/structures/ with a filter for ciuCode (structure status) and associatedContacts.
Decode decreedUses with the code list on the help page and check decreedUnits before comparing amounts.
reading_traps: decreedUnits mixes flow (CFS) and volume (AF); amounts are not comparable until the unit is read.
A structure appears on several rows, one per decreed line; counting rows is not counting structures.
Unfiltered /structures returns an error text asking for wdid, division, waterDistrict, county, gnisId or locationSearch.
The decreed amount is the legal entitlement, not diversion; diversion records are a separate endpoint family.

problems: A decreedUnits filter was ignored by netamount (row count unchanged), so unit mix was not measured.
Abandoned-right handling in net amounts was not tested.

evidence.quote: anonymous users are limited to 1,000 calls per day and 600,000 rows of data.

evidence.claim: Decreed units are CFS or AF.
evidence.quote: decreedUnits Decree Units (either CFS or AF)
ciuCodeLong: Structure abandoned by the court

how_to_use.example_result: HTTP 200 JSON: certificate 16266, surface water, irrigation, priority date 1882-07-15, rate 0.3 cfs, 4.5 acre-feet, with a wris_link to the WRIS record.
steps: List layers at the FeatureServer root: 78 layers, 39 'Points of Diversion' (3 source types x 13 use groups) and 39 'Places of Use'.
Query each POD layer with returnCountOnly=true or fetch features with resultOffset (maxRecordCount is 2000); or download CSV/GeoJSON per layer from Oregon GeoHub.
Follow wris_link for status, decree and place-of-use details.
Convert priority_date from epoch milliseconds.

acre_feet is filled for 4,061 of 57,926 surface-irrigation rows and 85 of 23,983 groundwater-irrigation rows; rate_cfs is far more common but can be 0.0.
There is no status field: the layers show current rights only, so cancelled or expired rights are absent rather than flagged.
Layers for Storage/Instream and Groundwater/Instream returned 0 rows.

problems: The documented compilation procedures PDF on arcgis.wrd.state.or.us timed out (30-40 s), so procedures were not read.
Total is the sum of count queries over the 39 POD layers; distinct rights were not computed.
